title: Technical Deflation and the VHIE: A Roadmap to Fiscal Sustainability
summary: This analysis details the fiscal impact of technical deflation within Vermont's healthcare infrastructure. By optimizing the VHIE liquidity fabric, we project a significant reduction in administrative overhead and a dividend for rural health reinvestment.

children.text: As the CTO for the Vermont Agency of Digital Services, I have prioritized technical deflation as our primary tool for health system sustainability. The legacy model of proprietary data silos creates a 'friction tax' that burdens every clinical encounter in our state.
STRATEGIC MANDATE: By Q3 2027, the Vermont Health Platform must achieve 90% real-time data liquidity across all rural critical access nodes.
